newsitem.title: USA: Bank United files for $220 mln in notes.
newsitem.headline: Bank United files for $220 mln in notes.

text.p: Bank United Corp said Wednesday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $220 million in subordinated notes.
Of the total, the company will offer $100 million worth of subordinated notes due 2004 and $120 million worth of subordinated notes due 2007.
A portion of the proceeds will be used to repurchase and retire the $115 million outstanding principal amount of the company's 8.05 percent senior notes due May 15, 1998.
Proceeds will also go toward general corporate purposes, which may include the acquisition of the stock or assets or financial institutions and the funding of internal growth.
The offering will be made through Smith Barney Inc, Lehman Brothers and Merrill Lynch & Co Inc.
Bank United, based in Houston, is a financial services provider to consumers and businesses in Texas and other selected regional markets throughout the United States.
